Popular Mint replacement. Paid (~$15/mo or $100/yr). - **YNAB (You Need A Budget)** - Two people can share one budget across devices. Strong for proactive budgeting. Paid (~$15/mo or $109/yr). - **Copilot** - Supports shared households (iOS/web). Paid. - **Empower (formerly Personal Capital)** - Free, good for net worth and investment tracking; less granular for budgeting.  **Things to consider when choosing:** 1. **Privacy controls** - Honeydue and Zeta let you hide specific accounts or transactions from your partner; most general apps show everything linked. 2. **Budgeting style** - YNAB is hands-on/zero-based; Monarch and Copilot are more flexible. 3. **Banking integration** - Zeta offers an actual joint account; others just track existing accounts. 4. **Cost** - Honeydue and Empower are free; the others charge.
